# Test declarative state tracking and orphan pruning

# Add a local repo that acts as our bundle provider
exec axen source add ./bundle-repo -n bundle-repo

# 1. Install frontend bundle
exec axen install bundle-repo -b frontend -t claude
stdout 'skill-a'
! stdout 'skill-b'
! stdout 'skill-c'

# Check lockfile tracking
grep '"frontend"' .axen/axen-lock.json

# 2. Update repo: bundle changes, skill-a removed, skill-b added
exec mv new-axen.json bundle-repo/axen.json
exec touch bundle-repo/axen.json
exec axen update bundle-repo
stderr 'pruned 2 orphaned skill'
grep '"skill-b"' .axen/axen-lock.json
! grep '"skill-a"' .axen/axen-lock.json

# 3. Explicitly install skill-c
exec axen install bundle-repo -s skill-c -t claude
stdout 'skill-c'
grep '"skill-c"' .axen/axen-lock.json

# 4. Remove frontend bundle
exec axen remove bundle-repo -b frontend
# skill-b should be removed because it was only in the bundle
! grep '"skill-b"' .axen/axen-lock.json
# skill-c should stay because it was explicit
grep '"skill-c"' .axen/axen-lock.json

-- bundle-repo/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "bundle-repo", "skills": {"skill-a": {"path": "."}, "skill-c": {"path": "."}, "dummy": {"path": "."}}, "bundles": {"frontend": {"skills": ["skill-a"]}, "default": {"is_default": true, "skills": ["dummy"]}}}
-- bundle-repo/SKILL.md --
# Skill
-- new-axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "bundle-repo", "skills": {"skill-b": {"path": "."}, "skill-c": {"path": "."}}, "bundles": {"frontend": {"skills": ["skill-b"]}}}
